name: Fenn
waitingLines: I can’t leave without seeing {partner}! What if it’s a SIGN?
I’ll just wait here for {partner}. Romantically. On your windowsill.

questions.scene: Fenn holds a glass of water up to the light, gazing through it dreamily.
lines: Imagine being so open your heart is visible.
questions.question: Which frog has see-through skin on its belly?

choices.label: The glass frog
reply: YES! You can see its heart beating!
Glass frogs have transparent bellies showing their organs.
Literally wearing their heart on their skin. Goals.

choices.label: The bullfrog
reply: Too chunky for transparency!
It's the glass frog.
You can actually watch its heart beat. Iconic.

choices.label: The tree frog
reply: Close, they're cousins!
The glass frog has the see-through belly.
Visible heart. The most romantic frog alive.

questions.factBasis: Glass frogs have translucent ventral skin.

questions.scene: Fenn clutches his stomach and flutters around your room.
lines: Ribbit! I have butterflies! Real ones! Not real ones. Science ones!
questions.question: What causes the 'butterflies in your stomach' feeling when you're nervous or crushing?

choices.label: Actual tiny butterflies
reply: Ribbit! Imagine! No!
It's adrenaline shifting blood away from your stomach.
Your body treats crushes like a big event. Because they are.

choices.label: Eating too fast
reply: Sometimes that too! But not this!
It's your stress response, sending blood away from your gut.
Nervous excitement. Heart racing. Stomach fluttering. Romance!

choices.label: Stress hormones like adrenaline shifting blood away from your gut
reply: YES! Your body's fight-or-flight mode!
Adrenaline sends blood to your muscles, so your stomach feels fluttery.
It's a SIGN your body thinks love is an emergency. It kind of is.

questions.factBasis: Butterflies are linked to sympathetic arousal (adrenaline), diverting blood from the digestive tract.

questions.scene: Fenn blinks a flashlight on and off in a secret pattern.
lines: That means 'I love you' in firefly. Probably.
questions.question: Why do fireflies flash their lights?

choices.label: To scare away birds
reply: They might warn predators too, but that's not the main thing.
The flashing is mostly how they find mates.
Each species has its own blinking pattern.

choices.label: To find and attract mates
reply: YES! Love lights!
Each species has its own flash pattern, like a love code.
Romance at night with built-in fairy lights. Swoon.

choices.label: To read at night
reply: Ha! A tiny library!
It's how they find and attract mates.
Every flash says 'Hey cutie.' In firefly.

questions.factBasis: Fireflies use species-specific flash patterns for courtship.

questions.scene: Fenn stares at a photo of Lily and his pupils go huge.
lines: My brain is doing something. Something chemical. It's LOVE.
questions.question: What happens in the brain when you're newly in love?

choices.label: The brain goes completely quiet
reply: Opposite! It's a party in there!
Early love activates reward areas powered by dopamine.
Love is literally a natural high. It's a SIGN.

choices.label: Reward areas light up with dopamine
reply: YES! Love lights up the reward system!
Brain scans show early love activates dopamine-rich reward areas.
Lily is basically my dopamine. Is that romantic? It's romantic.

choices.label: You forget your own name
reply: Feels like it! But no.
Reward regions rich in dopamine become very active.
Brain scans proved it. Love is real chemistry.

questions.factBasis: fMRI (Fisher, Aron et al.) shows early romantic love activates dopamine-rich reward regions (VTA, caudate).

questions.scene: Fenn grabs your hands and does a slow little twirl with you.
lines: It's about a morning dance. It's a SIGN.
questions.question: What do seahorse couples do each morning?

choices.label: Do a greeting dance together
reply: YES! Every morning! A dance!
Seahorse partners greet each other with a little dance, sometimes changing color.
Lily and I started doing this. She's better than me.

choices.label: Swim in opposite directions
reply: Ouch! No!
They do a morning greeting dance together.
Twirling, color changes, tail holding. Romance.

choices.label: Sleep in until noon
reply: Ha! Relatable. But no!
They meet each morning for a greeting dance.
Some even link tails. I'm crying.

questions.factBasis: Seahorse pairs perform daily greeting rituals.

questions.scene: Fenn wraps a scarf around his neck and shivers dramatically.
lines: Winter is coming. Like my feelings.
questions.question: What can wood frogs do to survive winter?

choices.label: Fly south with the birds
reply: Frogs can't fly. Tragically.
They freeze almost solid and thaw out in spring.
Natural antifreeze protects their cells. Science romance.

choices.label: Knit a sweater
reply: Ha! Cozy, but no.
They freeze almost solid and thaw in spring.
Their bodies make natural antifreeze to protect their cells.

choices.label: Freeze solid, then thaw in spring
reply: YES! It's wild!
Their hearts stop, they freeze, then thaw and hop away in spring.
Like love after a breakup. It always comes back.

questions.factBasis: Wood frogs survive partial freezing and thaw in spring.

questions.scene: Fenn holds up a photo of a tiny round rodent couple snuggling.
lines: These are my favorite romantics after frogs. Prairie voles!
questions.question: Why are prairie voles famous in love research?

choices.label: They're the fastest runners
reply: Not really known for speed!
They form lifelong pair bonds, unlike most rodents.
Scientists learned a lot about bonding hormones from them.

choices.label: They change color when in love
reply: Ribbit! I wish! No!
They form strong, often lifelong pair bonds.
They're used to study oxytocin and vasopressin. Love science.

choices.label: They form strong lifelong pair bonds
reply: YES! Little lovebirds, but voles!
They pair up for life, and scientists study them to understand bonding hormones.
Oxytocin heroes. I aspire to be a vole.

questions.factBasis: Prairie voles are socially monogamous and a model for pair-bonding neurobiology (oxytocin/vasopressin).

questions.scene: Fenn crawls through your yard on his hands and knees, searching the clover.
lines: I'm looking for a sign. A four-leaf sign. Very rare.
questions.question: About how rare is a four-leaf clover?

choices.label: 1 in 4
reply: Too common! Not a sign at all!
It's roughly 1 in 5,000 to 10,000 clovers.
Rare enough to feel magical.

choices.label: Roughly 1 in 5,000 to 10,000
reply: YES! Very rare! A real SIGN!
Most clovers have three leaves. Four is a rare genetic quirk.
If you find one, it's basically the universe winking at you.

choices.label: They don't exist
reply: They exist! I've found three! Signs!
About 1 in 5,000 to 10,000 clovers have four leaves.
Keep searching. It's worth it.

questions.factBasis: Estimates commonly cite ~1 in 5,000–10,000 white clovers as four-leaved.

questions.scene: Fenn flaps his arms frantically, trying to hover in place. He fails.
lines: These little birds can do something even I can't. And I'm a frog.
questions.question: What can hummingbirds do that no other birds can?

choices.label: Fly backwards
reply: YES! Backward flying!
Hummingbirds can hover, fly backward, and even briefly upside down.
Imagine flying backward into someone's arms. Romantic AND efficient.

choices.label: Swim underwater
reply: Ribbit, that's my job!
Hummingbirds are the only birds that can truly fly backward.
Wings beating dozens of times a second. Tiny powerhouses.

choices.label: Sleep while flying
reply: Some birds can! But not this one!
Hummingbirds are the only birds that can fly backward.
They hover like tiny helicopters. Precious.

questions.factBasis: Hummingbirds can hover and fly backward, unique among birds.

questions.scene: Fenn stares into the eyes of a puppy in a photo, smiling dreamily.
lines: Love isn't just for frogs. It's for dogs too. And their humans.
questions.question: What happens when dogs and their owners gaze into each other's eyes?

choices.label: The dog gets sleepy
reply: Maybe! But that's not the finding!
Mutual gazing increased oxytocin in both dog and owner.
Bonding through eyes. Pure romance.

choices.label: Both get a boost of oxytocin, the bonding hormone
reply: YES! Love hormone for both!
A study found mutual gazing raised oxytocin in dogs and their owners.
Eye contact equals love. It's a SIGN. For everyone.

choices.label: The owner sneezes
reply: Allergies! But no!
Both dog and owner showed a boost in oxytocin.
Your dog loves you scientifically.

questions.factBasis: Nagasawa et al. (2015): owner–dog mutual gaze increased oxytocin in both.

questions.scene: Fenn collapses onto your couch with both hands over his heart.
lines: Brace your heart. Love stories. Mine was love at first sight. Obviously.
questions.question: Your love story: love at first sight, or friends first?

choices.label: Love at first sight
reply: Love at first sight! Fireworks! Violins!
Zing. I knew it the moment Lily croaked hello.

choices.label: Friends first
reply: Friends first. Oh, that's so sweet.
Best friend turned love. My favorite plot.

A:A: Love at first sight for both of you! It's a SIGN!
{partner} saw you and you saw them and the universe just... clicked.
I'm crying. Ribbit. Sorry. Crying.
A:B: Friends first for you. {partner} says love at first sight.
They were head over heels on day one. You were just being friendly.
They've been patient this whole time. Give them a big hug.
B:A: Love at first sight for you. {partner} says friends first.
So you were in love from day one, and they took the scenic route.
Plot twist: you were waiting for them to catch up. Romantic!
B:B: Friends first for both of you. Slow burn magic.
So you and {partner} were best friends who slowly fell. Movie plot.
The best love stories start with 'we were just friends.'

questions.scene: Fenn holds up a ukulele with one string. He strums it. It's bad.
lines: Ribbit! Sorry. Excited. Grand gestures. I'm practicing one.
questions.question: Grand gesture: a public serenade, or a private candlelit picnic?

choices.label: Public serenade
reply: Public serenade! Bold! Iconic! Terrifying!
Strangers clapping. Partner blushing. Perfect.

choices.label: Private picnic
reply: Private picnic. Candles, cheese, whispers.
Intimate. Classy. Swoon.

A:A: Public serenade for both of you! Showstoppers!
Honestly, {partner} and you would serenade each other in the middle of a mall.
Bring a tambourine. For backup.
A:B: Private picnic for you. {partner} wants a public serenade.
They want the spotlight. You want the candlelight.
Let them sing at your picnic. Just you, them, and the moon.
B:A: Public serenade for you. {partner} wants a private picnic.
You'll sing in a crowd. They'll want to hide behind a basket.
Serenade them AT the picnic. Private concert. Audience of one.
B:B: Private picnic for both of you. Intimate love.
I can picture it: you and {partner} would light candles in a secret meadow.
Just watch for ants. They crash every picnic.

questions.scene: Fenn points at the sky, then the window, then the pond outside, overwhelmed.
lines: Oh my lily pads. Dream date. I have too many ideas.
questions.question: Dream date: under the stars, dancing in the rain, or by the water?

choices.label: Under the stars
reply: Under the stars! Constellations as witnesses!
I'd name a star after Lily. I did. It's unofficial.

choices.label: Dancing in the rain
reply: Dancing in the rain! Movie scene!
Wet hair, big smiles, zero regrets.

choices.label: By the water
reply: By the water! My home turf!
Ripples, reflections, and a gentle breeze.

A:A: Stars for both of you! It's a SIGN!
Lie on a blanket with {partner} and count the stars.
Wish on a shooting star. Wish for each other. Done.
A:B: Rain for you. {partner} wants to stargaze.
Dance in the rain until it clears. Then look up.
The stars come out just for you two.
A:C: Water for you. {partner} wants the stars.
Find a lake with an open sky.
Reflections and constellations. A cosmic date.
B:A: Stars for you. {partner} wants to dance in the rain.
Wait for the rain to stop. Then stargaze in wet clothes.
It's a SIGN of commitment.
B:B: Rain for both of you! Movie couple!
Pretty sure you and {partner} will splash in puddles while everyone else runs for cover.
Umbrellas are for people without romance.
B:C: Water for you. {partner} wants to dance in the rain.
Rain on a lake. The prettiest sound.
C:A: Stars for you. {partner} wants to be by the water.
A lake at night. Stars reflected in the water.
Double the stars. Double the romance.
C:B: Rain for you. {partner} wants to be by the water.
Dance in the rain by a lake. Water everywhere.
Very wet. Very romantic. Very froggy.
C:C: Water for both of you! Pond people!
Picture it: {partner} and you by a lake at sunset. Postcard material.
Skip stones. Make wishes. I'll provide the frogs.

questions.scene: Fenn writes 'Month 47' on your calendar in glitter pen.
lines: Listen. LISTEN. Anniversaries. I celebrate them monthly. Lily thinks I'm extra.
questions.question: Anniversaries: celebrate the monthly ones too, or just the yearly one?

choices.label: Monthly too
reply: Monthly too! YES! Every month is a gift!
Twelve chances a year to be cheesy.

choices.label: Just yearly
reply: Just yearly. Save the magic.
One big day. Very special.

A:A: Monthly celebrations for both of you! Extra couple!
{partner} and you probably have a cupcake every month.
It's a SIGN you're both as extra as me. I love it.
A:B: Yearly for you. {partner} wants monthly too.
They'll show up with a cupcake every month. Brace yourself.
Let them. Eat the cupcake. Say thank you. It's love.
B:A: Monthly for you. {partner} prefers just yearly.
They'll be surprised every month. You'll be delighted.
Keep monthly ones tiny. A note. A cookie. Not a parade.
B:B: Yearly for both of you. Classic and meaningful.
So you and {partner} make one day a year really count.
Big, beautiful, once a year. Like a comet.

questions.scene: Fenn finds a heart-shaped pebble and gasps loudly.
lines: Ribbit. Do you see what I see? It's a SIGN.
questions.question: Do you believe in signs?

choices.label: Absolutely
reply: Absolutely! Welcome to my world!
Heart-shaped clouds, matching songs. Signs everywhere.

choices.label: Not really
reply: Not really. Grounded. Practical.
Maybe the signs will find you anyway.

A:A: You both believe in signs! It's a SIGN!
Honestly, {partner} and you probably screenshot every lucky coincidence.
Cosmic couple. I'm adopting you both.
A:B: You don't believe. {partner} totally does.
They'll see signs everywhere. You'll see coincidences.
Let them have it. Their joy is the real sign.
B:A: You believe. {partner} doesn't.
You'll point out heart-shaped clouds. They'll say 'it's a cloud.'
Keep pointing. One day they'll see it.
B:B: Neither of you believes in signs. Practical love.
I can picture it: you and {partner} don't need signs. You chose each other.
Honestly, that's the biggest sign of all.

questions.scene: Fenn stares into your eyes intensely. Then blushes and looks away.
lines: Don't laugh. First impressions.
questions.question: What did your partner notice first about you?
questions.selfQuestion: What did you notice first about your partner?

choices.label: The smile
reply: The smile! Heart-melting.
One smile and it's over.

choices.label: The laugh
reply: The laugh! Musical!
A laugh you can't forget.

choices.label: The outfit
reply: The outfit! Fashion romance.
Love at first fit.

A:A: The smile, and {partner} knew it!
They've always known your smile had power over them.
It's a SIGN. Smile at them right now.
A:B: It was the laugh for you. {partner} guessed the smile.
They think it was the smile. It was the sound.
Laugh together. Prove it.
A:C: It was the outfit for you. {partner} guessed the smile.
They think you fell for their smile. You fell for their jacket.
Honest. Fashion matters. It's a SIGN.
B:A: It was the smile for you. {partner} guessed the laugh.
They think it was the laugh. It was the smile.
Tell them. Watch them smile again.
B:B: The laugh, and {partner} knew it!
They know your laugh is your secret weapon.
Laugh at their next joke. Even the bad ones.
B:C: It was the outfit for you. {partner} guessed the laugh.
They think you heard them first. You saw them first.
Wear that outfit on your next date.
C:A: It was the smile for you. {partner} guessed the outfit.
They think you noticed the clothes. You noticed the face.
Tell them their outfit was nice, but the smile won.
C:B: It was the laugh for you. {partner} guessed the outfit.
They think it was the fashion. It was the giggle.
Laughing in a cute outfit. Combo.
C:C: They know they dressed to impress that day.
Wear it again on your anniversary. Full circle.

questions.scene: Fenn leans close and whispers, 'Are you a pond? Because I'm drowning.'
lines: Okay. Deep breath. Pickup lines.
questions.question: How does your partner react to a cheesy pickup line?
questions.selfQuestion: How do you react to a cheesy pickup line?

choices.label: Groans, but blushes
reply: Groans but blushes! Classic!
Pretends to hate it. Secretly loves it.

choices.label: Fires one right back
reply: Fires one right back! A worthy opponent!
Pickup line battle. Nobody wins. Everyone giggles.

A:A: Groan-and-blush, and {partner} knew it!
They know your eye-roll always ends in a smile.
Keep the cheesy lines coming. It's a love language.
A:B: You fire one back. {partner} expected a blushing groan.
They thought you'd melt. You came back swinging.
Your comeback game is strong. Respect.
B:A: You groan and blush. {partner} expected you to fire back.
They're ready for battle. You're just pink.
Fire one back next time. Shock them.
B:B: Firing one right back, and {partner} knew it!
Pickup line duels are your thing.
It's a SIGN you're both ridiculous. Perfect match.

questions.scene: Fenn sniffles into a tissue, holding a rom-com DVD.
lines: Oh, this one's good. Rom-com endings. They destroy me.
questions.question: How does your partner react to a rom-com ending?
questions.selfQuestion: How do you react to a rom-com ending?

choices.label: Cries every single time
reply: Cries every time! A true romantic!
Tissues on standby. Always.

choices.label: Rolls eyes, secretly loved it
reply: Eye-roll, secret love. Classic!
Too cool to cry. Too soft to hate it.

A:A: You cry every time, and {partner} knew it!
They hand you tissues before the airport scene.
Cry proudly. I do. Every time.
A:B: You roll your eyes. {partner} expected tears.
They're ready with tissues. You're judging the plot.
Next time, cry a little. For them.
B:A: You cry every time. {partner} expected an eye-roll.
They thought you were too cool. You're a puddle.
Show them your tears. It's a SIGN of a big heart.
B:B: The eye-roll, and {partner} knew it!
They know you secretly loved it.
They saw you smile. You can't hide.

questions.scene: Fenn kisses the air, then blows another kiss toward the window.
lines: I'm emotional already. Rituals. I have 14.
questions.question: Which daily ritual would your partner never skip?
questions.selfQuestion: Which daily ritual would you never skip?

choices.label: Goodnight kiss
reply: Goodnight kiss! Every single night!
Sleep doesn't count without it.

choices.label: Morning 'good morning' text
reply: Good morning text! Sunrise love!
First thing they think of: you.

A:A: Goodnight kiss, and {partner} knew it!
They know no night ends without one.
Never skip. It's a SIGN of forever.
A:B: Morning text for you. {partner} guessed a goodnight kiss.
They think it's the kiss. It's the text.
Kiss them tonight anyway. Bonus love.
B:A: Goodnight kiss for you. {partner} guessed a morning text.
They think mornings matter. You think nights matter.
Do both. Text at sunrise. Kiss at moonrise.
B:B: Good morning text, and {partner} knew it!
Their phone lights up with your love every morning.
Sunrise and you. Perfect start.

questions.scene: Fenn gasps and points at the window. 'A shooting star!' It was a plane.
lines: Ribbit, ribbit. Wishes!
questions.question: If your partner saw a shooting star, what would they wish for?
questions.selfQuestion: If you saw a shooting star, what would you wish for?

choices.label: Something for you two
reply: Something for you two. Aww!
Their wish is about you. Swoon.

choices.label: Unlimited snacks
reply: Unlimited snacks! Honest!
Priorities. Respect.

A:A: Something for you two, and {partner} knew it!
They know your wishes always include them.
It's a SIGN. Forever and ever.
A:B: Unlimited snacks. {partner} thought you'd wish for you two.
They're touched. Then confused. Then hungry.
Share your wish snacks. Romance saved.
B:A: Something for you two. {partner} guessed unlimited snacks.
They thought you'd wish for snacks. You wished for them.
Tell them. They'll melt like chocolate.
B:B: Unlimited snacks, and {partner} knew it!
They know your heart, and your stomach.
Share the snacks. That's love.
